payload.body: Crate acceptance case: apps/android/app/src/main/java/dev/crate/data/CrateApi.kt selectSquareLocation currently must use POST /api/square/location. Server-side legacy POST is covered in Crate tests/squareLocations.test.ts only as a temporary compatibility fallback.
